integrity: The finite certificate computes all small determinants over a prime field using a primitive seventh root and proves complex nonvanishing by reduction. No numerical inference or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The six-point upper bound is proved for primes congruent to seven modulo 24; exact optimality is proved only for seven. The smallest-prime exclusion is computer-assisted by a fully specified exact integer certificate; no independent audit has been performed. No claim for other pairings or real coefficients.
title: Six-point self-disjoint Fourier supports in the previously untreated prime class, sharp over \(\mathbb F_7^2\)
